mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Racecards = today's races with runners and live odds. Results = finished races for past dates with finishing positions and starting prices.

dates.title: Result dates
dates.description: Results mode: dates as YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-03-13 (Cheltenham Gold Cup day). Up to 62. Empty = use Days back.

daysBack.title: Days back
daysBack.description: Results mode, when no dates are given: the last N days (1 = yesterday). Max 31.

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: Keep only meetings in these countries: UK (England, Scotland, Wales), Ireland, France, United States, and others Sporting Life covers. Empty = all.

courses.title: Courses
courses.description: Keep only these courses (partial match), e.g. Cheltenham, Ascot, Leopardstown, Kempton.

raceIds.title: Race IDs or URLs
raceIds.description: Specific Sporting Life races: the numeric race ID or the race URL. Overrides mode and dates.

includeOdds.title: Bookmaker odds per runner
includeOdds.description: Add every bookmaker price Sporting Life shows for each runner (with each-way terms). The best price is always included.

includeForm.title: Previous runs
includeForm.description: Add each horse's last 6 runs: date, course, distance, going, position, field size, odds, weight, rating and comment.

winnersOnly.title: Winners only
winnersOnly.description: Results mode: return only the winner of each race.

maxRunners.title: Max runners
maxRunners.description: Cap on rows returned. Controls cost.
